scope: M0-M5 manifest-locked backbone block kernel evidence with untracked boundary prepass and direct outer hipprof
supersedes_tool_protocol: v2 dynamic hipprof session control only; frozen failed v2/v3 run directories and their tool snapshots must remain unchanged

runtime.profiler_mode: direct outer process, matching the successful Phase 10 mode

static_lsmod.path_precedence: /work/runtime_tools is the first PATH entry before every ORT/Torch import

identity_rules: Every candidate final manifest is resolved under one authorized bundle root.
Every manifest-declared ONNX and MXR size/SHA256 is verified in the planner, boundary prepass, target, and summarizer.
The original sample keeps its .npy/.npz/.pt/.pth suffix in the untracked prepass and is identified by file SHA256 plus normalized float32 tensor SHA256.
Each boundary NPY and prepass result receives a host size/SHA256 receipt before the trace container starts; the target re-verifies both.
The boundary record contains canonical manifest identity, every upstream segment model/cache identity, target model/cache identity, and boundary tensor SHA256.
One trace may be reused across candidates only when segment index, precision, ONNX identity, and MXR identity are identical.

profile_scope.m5_increment_over_m0_m4: five new FP16 traces for blocks 15,16,19,20,21; identical INT8/FP16 ONNX+MXR identities remain deduplicated
profile_scope.head: FP32 compatibility head is outside the requested I8II/HBH backbone proof.
profile_scope.untracked_prepass: one normal container executes canonical segments 0 through target-1 with device OrtValue hand-off, then copies the target boundary once to a finite float32 NPY
profile_scope.traced_process: one fresh container launches hipprof directly around a Python process that creates only the selected segment session, uploads only the frozen boundary NPY, and executes the selected segment exactly 20 times
profile_scope.container_wait_timeout: each prepass/trace container is bounded by host docker-wait timeout, default 1800 seconds; timeout evidence is retained and the container is force-removed
profile_scope.smoke_mode: PHASE11_KERNEL_TASK_LIMIT=N selects the first N identity-sorted tasks and may prove only those selected tasks; it never proves a full 24-block candidate mapping
profile_scope.included_trace_setup: target session creation, MXR load, boundary H2D upload, output allocation, the 20 selected-segment calls, and the final output D2H used for finite/SHA validation are all visible to direct outer hipprof
profile_scope.isolation: one untracked prepass container plus one fresh direct-hipprof container per unique model+MXR block artifact

admission.provider_placement: selected block ORT profile has MIGraphX events > 0 and CPU events = 0
admission.device_residency: selected input and all selected outputs are device OrtValues
admission.trace_scope: Docker inspect proves direct /opt/dtk/bin/hipprof entrypoint, required trace flags, no dynamic/session flags, one boundary-input argument, and the one-block v3 target
admission.int8_kernel: I8II kernel token is present with calls >= selected-segment repetitions
admission.fp16_kernel: HBH kernel token is present with calls >= selected-segment repetitions
admission.missing_expected_token: record the block as failed; never infer native precision from placement or latency

overhead_accounting.gpu_kernel_denominator: sum of hipprof kernel CSV TotalDurationNs rows excluding Total
overhead_accounting.memcpy: HIP hipMemcpy* and HSA memory-copy API durations, each with its own API-table denominator
overhead_accounting.direct_trace_caveat: category durations include target session/setup, boundary H2D upload, output allocation, and final output D2H when applicable; report them as direct-trace scope, not isolated steady-state inference percentages
overhead_accounting.prohibition: Memcpy API durations are not added to GPU kernel durations and are not described as DMA-engine wall time.

outputs: one boundary NPY, prepass result, boundary receipt, and prepass container record per unique task
one target result, ORT profile, direct hipprof database/json/kernel CSV, logs, and trace-container inspect per unique task
